test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Each of the seven friends, Misha, Minshu, Mohi, Priya, Veer, Pari and Krishi, has a different height. Krishi is taller than only three people. Pari is taller than only Veer. Misha is taller than Minshu but not Mohi. Priya is taller than Mohi.

Who among the following is taller than Krishi?
solution:
**Explanation : **

 
• Pari is taller than only veer.
 
• Krishi is taller than only three people.

 ** ..... >.......>.......> Krishi .....> Pari > veer**

 
• Misha is taller than Minshu.
 
• Misha is shorter than Mohi.
 
• Priya is taller than Mohi.

 ** Priya > Mohi > Misha > Krishi > Minshu > Pari > Veer**

Hence,** Mohi **is taller than Krishi.
